Title: Configure load testing in your CI/CD pipeline from Azure portal

Body.Content:
Easily set up load testing in your CI/CD pipeline through a simple process in the Azure portal. Your test files, such as JMeter scripts and YAML configuration, will automatically be added to your repository. This enables automated pipeline runs, helping you detect performance issues early in the development cycle.

Learn more about automating your load tests in CI/CD
